import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text } from 'react-native'
import { styles } from './styles'

export function Keyboard() {
    return (<View style={styles.container} >

        <View style={styles.containerResultNumber}>
            <Text style={styles.textResultNumber}>0  0  0  0</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.containerNumber}>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>1</Text>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>2</Text>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>3</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={{
            flexDirection: 'row',
            justifyContent: 'space-around',
            alignItems: 'center'
        }}>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>4</Text>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>5</Text>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>6</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={{
            flexDirection: 'row',
            justifyContent: 'space-around',
            alignItems: 'center'
        }}>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>7</Text>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>8</Text>
            <Text style={styles.textNumber}>9</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={{
            flexDirection: 'row',
            justifyContent: 'space-around',
            alignItems: 'center',
            marginHorizontal: 25
        }}>
            <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                <Text style={{
                    fontSize: 20,
                    color: '#fff',
                    backgroundColor: '#17A2B7',
                    paddingHorizontal: 15,
                    paddingVertical: 5,
                    position: 'absolute',
                    borderRadius: 5
                }}>Limpar</Text>
            </View>


            <Text style={{ fontSize: 50, color: '#fff' }}>0</Text>

            <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                <Text style={{
                    fontSize: 20,
                    color: '#fff',
                    backgroundColor: '#26A744',
                    position: 'absolute',
                    paddingHorizontal: 10,
                    paddingVertical: 5,
                    borderRadius: 5
                }}>Concluir</Text></View>
        </View>

    </View >
    )
}
